why: Restores a subtitle sitting directly under the headline that already says it. The owner floated "Campaign run complete" instead of deleting; that is the same restatement in fewer words, so the line went rather than shrank. Anchored on the `action`/`chooseLevel` tail plus the comment delimiter that follows this entry, because `subtitle: ''` is the value of all five entries and `action: 'Start New Campaign'` is shared with `campaign-over` -- only the trailing `/*` separates them. An earlier version of this entry INSERTED a second `subtitle` key above the existing one and survived: a duplicate key is legal here and the LATER one wins, so the empty string was still what shipped. Recorded because the mutation looked obviously fatal and was not. RE-ANCHORED for issue #323, which added a `practiceThisLevel` term to every OUTCOME_PANEL entry: this entry's find string ran through the changed lines and stopped matching, so it reported FAILED-TO-APPLY -- a guard that had quietly stopped guarding.
